mapper.select: SELECT * FROM monitor_sourcemap WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND project_version = #{projectVersion} AND env = #{env} AND is_valid = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monitor_error_alert ( id, project_id, project_version, env, fingerprint, alert_content, alert_time,update_time ) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{projectVersion}, #{env}, #{fingerprint}, #{alertContent}, #{alertTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO monitor_error_fingerprint ( id, project_id, project_version, env, fingerprint, fingerprint_type, error_type,count, error_msg, first_occur_time, last_occur_time, sourcemap_file, is_resolved, resolve_time, level, remark, sdk_type, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{projectVersion}, #{env}, #{fingerprint}, #{fingerprintType}, #{errorType}, #{count},#{errorMsg}, #{firstOccurTime}, #{lastOccurTime}, #{sourcemapFile}, #{isResolved}, #{resolveTime}, #{level}, #{remark}, #{sdkType}, #{updateTime} )
